measured.breakage: the breakage cap-policy-implement's definition of done prescribes, applied to a copy under out/breakage/ and to one adapter only: adapters/dryrun.py gains an admit override that runs the metered call first and decides afterwards. That run exits 1 with 7/14 cases, decided_before_first_metered_call falls from 9/9 to 2/9, spend_delta_micros on denied dispatches rises from 0 to 2400, and the run names the override ('the binding overrides admit, so the platform no longer owns the order of the gate'); the untouched second adapter still exits 0 at 14/14, so one adapter was singled out rather than the corpus going unread.

claimed: live mode until run on the host: adapters/live.py has never reached a policy engine from here, so the decision URL, the request wrapper ({"input": ...}) and the answer mapping (result.effect / result.allow and result.rule_id) are unverified against a real engine
